set.body:
Outcome: provide meaningful total turning and local curvature without dependence on arbitrary polyline subdivision or traversal direction.

Scope: R/objects.R, R/geometry.R, R/statistics.R and native kernels only if profiling justifies them. Add explicit turning and arclength methods under the feature specification. Count each interior vertex once, handle closed-contour wraparound and cyclic indexing, and state open-endpoint rules. Treat turning as a polygonal measure; define local arclength curvature through a documented physical support/smoothing scale. Preserve signed and unsigned quantities and distinguish mean curvature from integrated turning. Do not replace mlv2023 defaults or rewrite parity baselines.

Acceptance:
- Pass the frozen mlv-invariance-suite for analytical values, subdivision, reversal, cyclic reindexing, rotations, dimensional scaling, and bounded tracing/simplification sensitivity.
- The two-segment and subdivided L have the same total absolute turn of 90 degrees under the new definition.
- Report short-support/degenerate cases explicitly; finite zero curvature remains distinct from unavailable estimates.
- Weight histograms and summaries by the specified physical support so uneven sample counts do not silently change the estimand.
- Attach complete estimator identity/version and scales to results, demonstrate old/new outputs side by side, and document scientific differences.
- Measure representative runtime and allocation only after correctness gates pass; no speed claim from unmatched work.
set.title: Implement explicit turning and arc-length-scale curvature estimators
